;Disasters and accidents
*[[Anshun bus crash]]
**A bus carrying students to [[National College Entrance Examination|an exam]] [[Bus plunge|plunges]] into a reservoir in [[Anshun]], [[Guizhou]], [[China]], killing 21 and leaving 16 injured. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-bus/bus-plunges-into-reservoir-in-china-21-dead-idUSKBN2481PV?il=0 (Reuters)]
*At least two people die and over 20 are injured when two [[train wreck|trains collide]] near [[Pernink]] in the [[Czech Republic]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-czech-crash/two-killed-in-train-collision-in-czech-republic-emergency-services-idUSKBN24826S (Reuters)]
*Hundreds of firefighters and rescue workers are deployed to battle [[wildfire]]s in [[Ukraine]]'s eastern [[Luhansk Oblast]]. The fires have killed six people and destroyed more than 120 houses. [[Governor of Luhansk Oblast|Luhansk Governor]] [[Serhiy Haidai]] says some of the fires may have been caused by [[arson]]. [https://www.thenational.ae/world/europe/hundreds-battle-deadly-ukraine-forest-fire-1.1045842 (''The National'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
****[[Sinovac Biotech]] is starting Phase III trials of its potential [[COVID-19 vaccine]] following a fast-track approval for the trials by [[Brazil]]ian regulators last week. The study, done in partnership with Brazilian vaccine producer [[Instituto Butantan]], will recruit nearly 9,000 healthcare professionals working in [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]-specialized facilities and start this month. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/07/china-sinovac-starts-late-stage-trials-covid-19-vaccine-200707052455342.html (Al Jazeera)]
****[[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jul/07/jair-bolsonaro-coronavirus-positive-test-brazil-president (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]]
****[[Chile]] surpasses 300,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.cooperativa.cl/noticias/sociedad/salud/coronavirus/covid-19-chile-supero-los-300-mil-contagios-con-26-340-casos-activos/2020-07-07/102600.html (Cooperativa)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Connecticut]]
****[[Connecticut]] reports zero deaths for the first time in four months. [https://thehill.com/changing-america/well-being/prevention-cures/506373-connecticut-reports-no-new-coronavirus-deaths (''The Hill'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Texas]]
****[[Texas]] surpasses 200,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/07/07/texas-surpasses-200-000-coronavirus-cases-after-holiday-weekend/5388970002/ (''USA Today'')]
***The United States has averaged just under 50,000 new cases daily over the last week, twice as high as a month ago. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/07/07/health/us-coronavirus-tuesday/index.html (CNN)]
***Contact tracing is no longer possible across the [[Southern United States]] due to rapid COVID-19 surges in the region. [https://myfox8.com/news/coronavirus/contact-tracing-is-no-longer-possible-across-the-us-south-due-to-rapid-coronavirus-surges-health-expert-says/ (Fox8)] [https://www.fox10tv.com/news/coronavirus/contact-tracing-is-no-longer-possible-across-the-us-south-due-to-rapid-coronavirus-surges/article_23dd6179-97fd-52bf-9adb-c4f03c6811a0.html (Fox10)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
***Iran reports a record high death toll of 200 in the last 24 hours. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/coronavirus/2020/07/07/Coronavirus-Iran-reports-200-new-deaths-in-24-hours-record-high.html (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

;International relations
*[[Assassination of Qasem Soleimani]]
**[[United Nations special rapporteur]] on [[extrajudicial killing|extrajudicial]], summary or arbitrary executions [[Agnès Callamard]] concludes, in a report to be presented at the [[United Nations Human Rights Council]], that the killing of [[Qasem Soleimani]] in January by the [[United States]] was "unlawful". Callamard says that based on U.S. evidence, the killing was "arbitrary" and "violated the UN charter". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/07/killing-iran-qasem-soleimani-unlawful-expert-200707132312296.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*[[Censorship in Vietnam]]
**In what is seen as an increase in arrests of political activists, a court in [[Vietnam]] sentences a 29-year-old [[Facebook]] user to eight years in prison for making anti-[[government of Vietnam|government]] posts, including several criticizing [[communist]] leader [[Ho Chi Minh]]. The man was also sentenced to serve three years of [[house arrest]] after finishing his prison term. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-vietnam-security-trial/vietnam-jails-facebook-user-for-eight-years-over-anti-state-posts-idUSKBN24814T (Reuters)]
*[[Tom Meighan]], former lead vocalist of the band [[Kasabian]], pleads guilty to assaulting his former partner. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2020/jul/07/former-kasabian-frontman-tom-meighan-admits-assaulting-ex-fiancee (''The Guardian'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ecuador]]
***[[Vice President of Ecuador|Vice President]] [[Otto Sonnenholzner]] resigns over the [[government of Ecuador|government]]'s handling of the [[COVID-19 pandemic]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ecuador-politics/ecuadors-vice-president-resigns-after-leading-state-covid-19-response-idUSKBN2482FS?il=0 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Serbia]]
***Thousands of people protest outside the [[House of the National Assembly of the Republic of Serbia]] in the capital [[Belgrade]], in response to [[President of Serbia|President]] [[Aleksandar Vučić]]'s plan on introducing stricter lockdown measures in Belgrade, due to the rising number of COVID-19 cases in the city. A small group of protesters storm the building after pushing through a police cordon. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-serbia-protests/demonstrators-storm-serbian-parliament-in-protest-over-lockdown-idUSKBN24835R?il=0 (Reuters)]
*The [[United States]] officially declares its intent to withdraw from the [[World Health Organization]] in 2021. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jul/07/us-officially-notifies-world-health-organization-of-its-withdrawal (''The Guardian'')]
